thread:
Maya: Quick question — the new compact spacing tokens + xxs button padding seem to make toasts overlap the FAB on the dashboard. Anyone else hitting this?
Aj: Yep saw that on /workloads when density=compact. Toast pops up over the sort dropdown and hides the caret.
Maya: Screenshot posted in thread. tinyimg.com/rdw-toast-fab (mock)
Sam: I think it’s a combo of lowered --space-2 for sticky elements and the toast using absolute overlay. We moved bottom gap in the last tokens PR.
Frank: Also worth calling out a11y: shrinking vertical padding on buttons reduced the hit area below 44px in a few cases, so toast overlap creates a tap trap.
Olivia: Proposed quick fixes: 1) enforce a min gap for sticky toasts (space-4), 2) compute FAB offset from that token so things don't collide.
Aj: Prefer token-driven approach so it responds to density toggle. Example:
```
--toast-sticky-gap: var(--space-4);
.toast.sticky { bottom: var(--toast-sticky-gap); }
.fab { bottom: calc(var(--toast-sticky-gap) + var(--fab-height)); }
```
Sam: That calc should be token-only, no hardcoded px, because customers can override spacing tokens. Also add a hook for when sticky header exists (tables with density compact + sticky header).
Maya: Good call. We should enumerate scenarios in the tokens RFC: compact density + sticky table header, compact density + floating FAB, and full-width banners.
Olivia: I'll add those to the RFC and include acceptance criteria + visual regression snapshots. Also adding an a11y note: buttons must maintain 44px touch target; if token change reduces it, we need compensating hit-target padding.
Design-bot: Created issue #4821: "fix: toast overlap on compact density with FAB" assigned to @Olivia
Maya: For compatibility — do we ship a compat flag for existing dashboards or treat as a minor breaking UI change?
Aj: Customers using pinned layouts might prefer a flag. Suggest a feature flag behind tokens.v2 that keeps old bottom values until enabled.
Frank: If we add a flag, make sure the QA plan covers both flows and the e2e snapshots for both.
Sam: Quick QA steps to add: 1) go to /workloads with density toggle, 2) toggle compact, 3) trigger toast via console: `window.__rdw_toast.success('test')`, 4) verify FAB and table controls are not covered, 5) test on mobile viewport.
Maya: I'll draft the changelog blurb and the migration notes. Olivia — ping me once RFC is updated and I'll schedule a short design review tomorrow. :thumbsup:
Olivia: Will do, adding screenshots and token snippets. ETA EOD today.
Maya: Thanks team — appreciate the quick triage.
summary: Compact spacing tokens caused toasts to overlap FAB on compact-density pages; team agreed token-driven gap + FAB offset, RFC updates, QA checklist, and optional compat flag.
